title: Bug: master/202505, multi-asic device's configuration can't be refreshed after deploy-mg
author: yejianquan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

In master/202505 (after https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/17024/files), multi-asic device's configuration can't be fully refreshed after deploy-mg.
Because in the function get_multiasic_feature_config, it queries all running configuration and write into golden_config_db.json.
And after https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/13604 , the golden configuration will overwrite minigraph.xml configuration.

If we have unexpected configuration in running config, e.g. METADATA.slice: "AZNG_Production", it can't be refreshed.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Install 202505 image on multi-asic devices.
2. Run deploy-mg

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior: the configuration can't be fully refreshed
Expected behavior: the configuration should be fully refreshed
